purpose.summary: This is a patient co-payment (patient burden amount) calculation subroutine for inpatient (hospital admission) billing, part of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software system. It computes the patient's share of medical costs under various Japanese health insurance schemes, handling numerous regional and special-case rules. It is called by higher-level billing programs to determine how much the patient owes.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance)

notable_features: Extremely large single COBOL source file (~1.4 MB, 28,257 lines)
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, rendered as Latin-1 mojibake)
Very long revision history spanning 2002–2009 with 100+ named revisions
92 CALL statements (calls to external subroutines for insurance rule lookups)
685 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3
No COPY statements (copy_count=0) — all data definitions inline
Part of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt software project for Linux
verdict.notes: The file is decoded as Latin-1 but the Japanese comments are actually EUC-JP encoded, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software from the well-known Japanese ORCA project. The large size (1.4 MB) and extensive revision history confirm long-term production use. The dialect is almost certainly GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL given the Linux target and ORCA project context.
